description: This file defines classes and types for handling Ambiorix variants, including wrappers around amxc_var_t structures, utility classes for access, and methods for creating, setting, getting, and managing variant data. It is part of a larger framework related to the beerocks namespace and appears to be focused on variant data management within the prplMesh project.

classes.name: AmbiorixVariantBaseAccess
classes.description: Utility class providing access to the internal amxc variant pointer, intended for limited use.

classes.name: AmbiorixVariant
classes.description: Wrapper class for amxc_var_t, providing methods to create, manage, and manipulate variant data, including type setting, value setting/getting, hierarchy navigation, and memory management.

methods.name: AmbiorixVariant
methods.description: Constructors for AmbiorixVariant. Include default, external reference, copy, and move constructors.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new smart pointer to an AmbiorixVariant with internal context.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Factory method for creating a smart pointer to an AmbiorixVariant bound to external data, with automatic freeing.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Factory method for creating a smart pointer wrapping external data without ownership transfer.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Methods to set the variant value with various data types.

methods.name: T get() const
methods.description: Methods to retrieve the variant value as various data types.

methods.name: find_child
methods.description: Find a child variant by key or index.

methods.name: find_child_deep
methods.description: Recursively find a nested child variant by path.

methods.name: first_child
methods.description: Retrieve the first child of a composite variant.

methods.name: last_child
methods.description: Retrieve the last child of a composite variant.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detach a variant from its parent hierarchy.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Build vectors or maps of child variants.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Check if the variant context is empty.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reset the variant context to an empty state.

methods.name: set_type
methods.description: Set the type of variant data.

methods.name: get_type
methods.description: Retrieve the current type of variant data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Add custom variables to the variant.
